name: Natural Language to Verified Mumei
description: 自然言語の銀行送金要件から forge task spec JSON を抽出し、.mm コード生成と mumei verify までを2層で検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: 自然言語の要件テキストから Mumei 仕様を抽出...
Step 2: 抽出した spec から .mm コードを生成...
Step 3: mumei verify で最終検証...
narrative.before: 人間はラフなテキストで要件を記述するだけ
narrative.after: AIが仕様を抽出し、コードを生成し、Z3が検証する

steps.extract_spec: 自然言語 → forge task spec JSON
steps.generate_code: spec JSON → .mm コード生成 + self-healing

steps.name: Agent Spec Extraction
artifact_contract: spec_text.md natural-language requirements trace into atoms[].requires/ensures.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Extracted spec written).

steps.name: Agent Code Generation
artifact_contract: generated.mm must be derived from extracted_spec.json and retain transfer pre/postconditions.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Generated verified code written).

steps.name: Z3 Generated Code Verification
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the verifier gate evidence.
verify_code.log records the Z3 acceptance marker for generated.mm.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed).

harness_contract.intent: Trace natural-language transfer requirements through extracted spec, generated Mumei code, and final Z3 verification.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/nl_to_verified/spec_text.md or requirements_en.txt, scenarios/nl_to_verified/expected/extracted_spec.json in fixture mode, and ../mumei-agent extraction/generation commands in live mode.
Generate evidence: extracted_spec.json, generated.mm, harness_state.json, result.json, report.md, and per-step logs in reports/{scenario}/latest/.
harness_state.json persists policy, compliance, intent fidelity, artifact inventory, and verification evidence for dashboard replay.
result.json records extraction, generation, final verification gates, artifact payload previews, and verification_evidence rows.
extracted_spec.json is the L2 artifact proving requirements were converted to structured spec.
generated.mm is the L2 generated implementation consumed by L1.
verify_code.log is the L1 Z3 evidence that generated.mm satisfies the extracted transfer contract.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l2_agent -> l1_z3; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Natural-language banking requirements must map to a structured forge spec and verified Mumei implementation.
success_criteria: Requirement 1 maps to requires: from_balance >= amount.
Requirement 3 maps to ensures: result == from_balance - amount.
extract_spec writes extracted_spec.json, generate_code writes generated.mm, and verify_code accepts generated.mm with Verification passed.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Medium: intent fidelity depends on extraction quality, so extracted_spec.json is retained as review evidence.
